manifest.holdout_version: gold-v1.1 (v0 superseded before any evaluation: added no-circuit-twice constraint)

freeze.note: Model rules frozen as sealed at C0 (commit 0e3c9c4). `git log 0e3c9c4..HEAD -- pipeline.py model_v2.py features.py strategy2.py` lists exactly one commit, 02f4c00 ('Naming final'), whose only change to these files is a display-label rename in pipeline.py (docstring 'ClearStint pipeline' -> 'Orb v1 pipeline'; strategy view labels 'ClearStint' / 'ClearStint, band low|high' -> 'Orb v1' / 'Orb v1, band low|high'). No estimator, feature, gate threshold (min_practice_laps, min_slope), factor rule, fuel/traffic prior or provider rule changed since the seal; model_v2.py, features.py and strategy2.py are byte-identical to 0e3c9c4. Provider frozen: provider_A_v2 (pre-race forecast curves from out/lock_v2.json). The 16:55 and 21:15 aggregates were dry runs before this freeze and are never quoted; only the evaluator run made under this freeze at commit cdb1a45a2f7b7bc7e94b8dfe342630eed208ec8e is quotable, always as 'sealed holdout, aggregate only'.
model_rule_commits_since_seal: 02f4c00 Naming final: Orb v1 as product and team name; documents, deck, lock and dashboard regenerated

quotable_rule: quotable is true only for a run produced under a valid freeze.json (model_frozen, feature_list_frozen, gate_threshold_frozen, provider_frozen all true and a git_commit); a dry run before the freeze is never quoted anywhere
data_cutoff: seasons 2023 to 2025 complete; each sealed weekend is forecast from its own practice files and factors from the non-sealed weekends of its season

units.degradation: s/lap per lap of tyre age
units.hidden_stop: s (next lap) and s over h laps (cumulative)

method.forecast: model_v2 stint fixed effects + per-compound slope on tyre age on cleaned practice; transfer factor, fallback floor and conformal widening from the season pool (pipeline.py rules); strict leave-out
method.reference: race-derived pace-loss reference: model_v2.fit on the race, all drivers (post-race, scoring only)
method.regret: held-out strategy replay under a post-race reference model
method.cells: cells with fewer than 3 weekends are suppressed; no per-weekend value is written to the aggregate file
